main_text.p: Levitas,Levitas est qualitas caloris plerumque comes & foboles, per quam corpus naturaliter furfum evehi poteft, ei adverfatur Gravitas.
Corpus igitur leve eft, quod furfū facile per fe movetur: Et fuo motu tedit furfū.
Frigoris comites funt ut plurimum Denfitas & Gravitas.
Denfitas,Denfitas eft qualitas frigoris comes & foboles, per quam partes corporis conftringuntur, & compactae redduntur, feu:

p.i: Eft qualitas fub parva quantitate multum conftringens & continens materiae.

main_text.p: Ei adverfatur Raritas, fub magna quantitate parvam continens materiam.
Denfum itaq; corpus eft, quod partes habet conftrictas, & folide cohaerentes feu compactas.
Denfatio vero eft partium in corpore appropinquatio, compactio, & propior unitio; Eftq; humidi, ne diffluat, in corpore cohibitio & conftrictio.
Gravitas,Gravitas eft qualitas frigoris comes & foboles, qua corpus deorfum vergit, moveturque.

page.notes: The printed "Corpus" at the start of the second paragraph is set with a superscript form; read as Corpus. Macrons over u in "furfū" and "tedit" are read from a small mark and may be doubtful. Faint show-through text in the margins and at the top left was ignored.
